reviews.title: Trinity SL
reviews.comment: Love the look and performance. So quiet can't even tell its running. It mounted perfect.
reviews.author: Taryn Adams

reviews.title: Great performance.
reviews.comment: I just buildt a new pc and decided to go with an AIO over air cooled. The performance of this is top notch, the fans are whisper quiet even at the highest RPM. I have a Ryzen 9 7950x3d and with 100% cpu utilization I sit around 69 degrees. So normal use or gaming  keeps my temps nice and cool and quiet.
reviews.author: Victor

reviews.title: Beautiful and Quiet.
reviews.comment:
I've been using this fan in my custom built PC since Dec, 2023 and I've had no issues at all.
It's very quiet and has so many color/pattern options. It's been a 5 star product all the way.
reviews.author: D.J.
